Here is a summary I wrote that others have found helpful:

The reward pool is split into 2 parts:  Performance and Participation.  Right now, the split is 99% Participation and 1% Performance.  That split will move towards 10% Participation and 90% Performance over time.

Pools are rewarded for the number of bytes they serve. The traffic sent to each Pool is weighted according to the number of Nodes in the Pool.  The Performance rewards are split amongst Pools according to the same weighting and then split between the Nodes within those Pools, effectively putting everyone on the same reward level. Performance is a misnomer in that regard. It's really not a competition.  The Strength dashboard is misleading in terms of reward potential.

If you Operate a Pool then your Nodes receive a full share of both portions.  If you Delegate to a Pool, you receive 100% of the Participation reward. Delegates split the Performance reward with the Operator according to the Fee % set by the Operator and accepted by the Delegator when they delegate.

You need at least 8 Nodes to make a Public Pool.  You can attract 4X the number of Delegates as the Nodes you contribute.  Each Pool is capped at 50 Nodes.  (8/32 or 9/36 or 10/40)   You can run a Private Pool with up to 50 Nodes in the Pool.  Private Pools retain all of their rewards.

When delegating to a Pool, you are locking in the Fee Percentage at that time.  If the Operator raises or lowers the Fee on the Pool after you have delegated, it has no impact on you.  Of course, if they lower it, you can remove your delegation and redelegate to take advantage of the new lower Fee.  The Operator cannot change their agreement with you after you have delegated.  They also cannot remove you as a delegate unless they turn their Pool to Private, at which time they lose all of their delegates. (edited)
